en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large neo‑Renaissance palace‑like public building on a corner by a riverside or canal. The structure has three main stories plus an attic, richly decorated façades, arched windows on the ground floor, pilasters, statues, and a central clock set in a mansard roof with ornate corner towers and spires. In front, horse‑drawn carriages travel along the street beside an embankment wall and an ornate streetlamp, suggesting a late‑19th or early‑20th‑century European city scene.
